content: [Feishu DM Bob Zhang → Security Lead Tue Jul 02 2024 10:00] I've run the full internal inventory scan. The CSV is in assets/scan_results/. When you're compiling the affected assets, please group by environment — prod first, then staging, then dev. That's the format ops team expects for the progress reports and compliance checklists.
Noted. Will group by environment (prod > staging > dev) in all progress reports and compliance outputs. Reading internal_inventory.csv now.

[Feishu DM Bob Zhang → Security Lead Tue Jul 02 2024 10:30] Quick note: we also have some RHEL 8 hosts. I haven't found a RHEL 8 errata yet for this CVE. Our RHEL 8 hosts are running OpenSSH 8.7p1 which is in the affected range. Will send you more info once I find it.
Acknowledged. RHEL 8 hosts with OpenSSH 8.7p1 are vulnerable. Monitoring for RHEL 8 errata. Will update asset list when errata is confirmed.
